limits: No timing, RSS, memory, execution or binary-size improvement is established.
The engine operand/call stack, heap and process memory are outside the linear C-frame bound.
Normal returns restore the stack global; arbitrary trapping invocation reuse is not authorized.
Both analyzed artifacts retain their original 16MiB stack reservations and build records. They were not rebuilt at the analyzer commit.
Every recorded original input digest matches the analyzer checkout; historical inventories are not relabelled as fresh current compiler inventories.
No builder/release adoption: independent smaller-stack semantic/lifecycle controls, complete gates and RSS/latency studies remain required.
All existing frontend cost losses and the unfinished universal-source cutover remain binding.
